positions.title: Senior Android Software Developer
positions.locationName: Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Senior Android Software Developer
MoneyHero - Save Money, RedRiver Lab, Oklahoma City, OK, Nov’21-Present

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.moneyhero&hl=en_IN&gl=US

MoneyHero is an ideal app to manage your money, its operation is very simple, just indicate your main monthly income, your fixed expenses and mark a saving goal, from this, you will know the money you have left to spend (we call it variable), this variable is the one that we will monitor so that you do not pass and meet your saving goal.

Reviewed Kotlin code and made multiple changes to code functions.  
Implemented biggest spending feature in the app to display what is the category on which customer spends more money.
Maintained internal analytics SDK to post and keep track of the KPIs.
Using Android Studio with Kotlin codebase following MVVM architecture. 
Implemented MVVM architecture with a Repository layer to better abstract data models from the UI components. 
Encrypted and decrypted the shared preference data with the Crypto Security Library from Android Jetpack. 
Involved in the new feature to display the new subscription and create a service to allow cancellation of the subscription through the application.
Actively consumed, parsed, and created JSON using GSON and Jackson libraries. 
Collaborated with Material Design UI/UX implementations with CardViews, RecyclerView, and Navigation Drawer navigation. 
Involved in main communication with managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements to technical stories.
Applied Android JetPack components such as Room, Navigation, and LiveData. 
Participated in software design, estimation of development tasks, testing, QA process, pair programming, troubleshooting, and code debugging. 
Implemented TDD using MockK and Espresso testing tools to test cases in business and an abstract layer of the architecture. 
Implemented multiple Custom Views to reduce the complexity of the Fragment lifecycle and increase code reusability.

positions.title: Android Mobile App Developer
positions.locationName: Manasquan, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.seattleapplab.jerseymikes&hl=en_CA&gl=US

Cut the line & order on the go! It's easy with the Jersey Mike's App to order & customize your favorite items, whether you like it Mike's Way® or want to create your own combination.

The app allows you to earn Shore Points® on every purchase of a sub, even our kids' meals and catering boxes. Want to know the best part about earning points? It's redeeming them! You can easily redeem points through the app when you make a purchase or by using a QR code to scan in-store. 

Implemented Firebase analytics framework to track user behavior in the app. 
Implemented push notifications features with Firebase’s Cloud Messaging Service. 
Implemented Android Jetpack libraries like ViewModel, LiveData, MediatorLiveData, and Navigation components. 
Architect background and multithreading operations using Kotlin Coroutines and defining custom Dispatchers for better resource control. 
Created the location module to enable the location and display to the user the closest locations.
Worked on an existing large codebase in MVVM architecture with data-binding implementation. 
Used LeakCanary to manage, trace and fix memory leaks issue within the Android app. 
Applied Roboelectric, Mockito, and Espresso for testing. 
Created token-based databases to secure data locally and server side
Implemented newer features in Kotlin and migrated older features coded in Java to Kotlin.  
Added push notification features with Firebase Cloud Messaging for Android. 
Implemented Push Notifications and set up a Google developer account and created a local key in the app base code. 
Refactored Dagger 2 library and implemented ViewComponents using Android Hilt library.
Implemented WorkManager to perform DataBase synchronization to keep track and reduce backend load. 
Used Atlassian Bamboo as a continuous integration system to track released versions with all fixes detailed in a changelog and code backup.

positions.title: Android Application Software Developer
positions.description:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.creditonebank.mobile 

Zelle® has partnered with leading banks and credit unions across the U.S. to bring you a fast, safe, and easy way to send money to friends and family. Money moves quickly - directly from a bank account to a bank account. If your bank or credit union offers Zelle, you already have it in your mobile banking app or online banking – if they don’t, the Zelle app will make it easy for you to send money to enrolled Zelle users that already have access through their financial institution.

Zelle. This is how money moves.

Interacted with the Backend team to display the correct data format in devices.  
Managing data and download tasks with multithreading and memory management on the device with work manager
Implement backend business logic using Servlets, and used Servlets for Applicant registration, login, and updating the user account. 
Leveraged Keychain to securely store sensitive user information. 
Designed and built flexible UI using Auto-Layout with complex interactions, animations, drop-downs, and expandable input areas. 
Worked closely with a cross-functional team of testers and developers.  
Continuously provide input to project management activities throughout the project life cycle, influencing scope, risk plan, project plan, issues, and status.
Worked with Git to check outthe codebase, manage merges and commits, and update the codebase changes. 
Segregated API Handler classes based on workflows, login services, user profiles, search items, categories, and coupons. 
Integrated Touch ID capabilities using Local Authentication. 
Worked on user registration for the application. 
Worked with the testing team to develop and document test plans and test cases with the help of Unit Testing.
Added animation between UI Views for a smooth transition and better user experience.

positions.title: Android App Developer
positions.locationName: New Castle, Delaware, United States · On-site
positions.description:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.performly.intra&hl=en_IN&gl=US

Performing Intranet application 

Implemented observable data patterns using JetPack LiveData to make server data observable.  
Applied and integrated Atlassian Cloud into a JumpCloud cloud service user directory.  
Utilized Room database for shared preferences for storage and caching.  
Worked in a fast-paced cross-functional Agile team with daily Scrum meetings and Sprints. 
Created testing (unit testing and integration testing) suites with Espresso and Mockito. 
Worked closely with UI/UX designers and interacted with stakeholders, product managers, and business units to gather requirements and ensure the final product matched needs. 
Performed gRPC Authentication, including gRPC’s built-in error codes, with the use of SSL/TLS to authenticate the server and encrypt all data exchanged between the client and the server.     
Implemented the UI and integrated custom analytics and security SDKs for new features and initiatives. 
Implemented Single Source of truth defining a Room DB for cache controller and updating backend data each day. 
Collaborated in an Agile environment following three weeks of sprint and having a code freeze for QA retrospective. 
Closely collaborated with UI/UX designers and created several custom views to follow UI specs. 
Practiced pair programming as part of collaborative project development/delivery strategy. 
Utilized Android SDK and supporting development devices.   
Participated with DevOps and customizing Jenkins pipelines to enforce a minimum of 85% of code coverage across the entire application.

positions.title: Jr. Android Developer
positions.description:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mapmyrun.android2

Whether you're just starting your fitness journey or are a seasoned runner, this app has what you need to stay on track and motivated to hit your goals. Get customizable Training Plans, personalized coaching tips to make running feel easier, and an inspiring community of over 60 million athletes, all supporting your shared commitment to health and fitness.
 
Fixed critical issues relating to Android Wear modules and notifications.  
Tested Android application with Robotium and Robolectric testing tools. 
Implemented PayPal’s Invoicing API to create and send invoices along with billing plans and billing agreements to create an agreement for a recurring PayPal or debit card payment   
Built the essential web services to handle the content data retrieval from databases using REST services 
Implemented Push Notifications and set up a Google developer account and created a local key in the app base code. 
Made use of Android SDK components, Activities, Broadcasts, Services, Intents, Job Scheduler, Custom Views, Constraint Layout, Fragments, Looper, Handlers, Shared Preferences, etc. 
Coded Connection and Operation error handling module to catch display messages to users during Bluetooth communication.  
Used volley library for automatic scheduling of network requests to get user profile and monthly stats data in a custom view.  
Practiced pair programming to develop the features, write TDD test cases, and write an algorithm for distance tracker and mile counter.  
Utilized Android Plot graph library to display distance, pace, speed, elevation gained, and calories burned in a pie chart and bar charts.
